autoEscape.zh-CN: 是否自动转义 searchWords 中的正则特殊字符。
autoEscape.en-US: Whether to escape regular expression characters in searchWords.

searchWords.zh-CN: 需要高亮的文本：字符串、字符串数组，或带 text、class、style 的对象数组。
searchWords.en-US: Text to highlight: a string, a string array, or an array of objects with text, class and style.

classNames.zh-CN: 内部各部位的类名，键为 highlight（每个高亮标签），与组件自带的类名合并。
classNames.en-US: Class names of the inner parts, keyed by highlight (every highlight tag); merged with the built-in classes.

styles.zh-CN: 内部各部位的样式，键为 highlight（每个高亮标签），值的键使用 CSS 属性名（如 `'border-radius'`）；数值不会补 px，长度要写成字符串。
styles.en-US: Styles of the inner parts, keyed by highlight (every highlight tag). Keys are CSS property names such as `'border-radius'`; numbers get no px, so write lengths as strings.

component.en-US: Tag name of the highlight element.
